March 13, 2018 - By Louis Casey 
Eulav Asset Management increased British Amern Tob Plc (BTI) stake by 266.95% reported in 2017Q3 SEC filing. Eulav Asset Management acquired 110,204 shares as British Amern Tob Plc (BTI)’s stock rose 13.21%. The Eulav Asset Management holds 151,486 shares with $9.46M value, up from 41,282 last quarter. British Amern Tob Plc now has $134.33 billion valuation. The stock decreased 1.13% or $0.67 during the last trading session, reaching $58.35. About 924,041 shares traded. British American Tobacco p.l.c. (NYSEMKT:BTI) has risen 17.78% since March 13, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 1.08% the S&P500. 
Torray Llc increased American Intl Group (AIG) stake by 25.99% reported in 2017Q3 SEC filing. Torray Llc acquired 39,368 shares as American Intl Group (AIG)’s stock declined 2.08%. The Torray Llc holds 190,836 shares with $11.72M value, up from 151,468 last quarter. American Intl Group now has $50.55B valuation. The stock decreased 1.06% or $0.6 during the last trading session, reaching $56.01. About 4.51 million shares traded. American International Group, Inc. (NYSE:AIG) has risen 8.59% since March 13, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 8.11% the S&P500. 
Among 7 analysts covering British Amrcn Tobacco ( NYSEMKT:BTI ), 5 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 1 Hold. Therefore 71% are positive. The firm has “Overweight” rating given on Wednesday, November 2 by Morgan Stanley. Cowen & Co initiated the shares of BTI in report on Tuesday, August 25 with “Market Perform” rating. Bank of America reinitiated the shares of BTI in report on Tuesday, August 4 with “Buy” rating. On Friday, July 29 the stock rating was downgraded by Societe Generale to “Hold”. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Thursday, September 8 by Investec. The stock has “Buy” rating by Investec on Friday, August 4. On Friday, October 28 the stock rating was upgraded by Societe Generale to “Buy”. The stock has “Overweight” rating by Piper Jaffray on Thursday, May 25.
